title: Sections over a finite separable field extension are stalk invariants
statement: Let $K$ be a field [def-pc-field-extension], $K^{\rm sep}$ a separable closure [def-kun-separably-closed] embedded in an algebraic closure $\Omega$, $G=\operatorname{Gal}(K^{\rm sep}/K)$ with its Krull topology, and $\bar s:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to\operatorname{Spec}K$ the geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point]. Let $F$ be a sheaf of sets on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] of $\operatorname{Spec}K$, with stalk $M=F_{\bar s}$ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks] and the action of $G$ induced by changing the lifts in pointed etale neighbourhoods. For each finite separable intermediate field $K\subseteq L\subseteq K^{\rm sep}$, put $H_L=\operatorname{Gal}(K^{\rm sep}/L)$. Restriction to the chosen lift of $\bar s$ gives a bijection $F(\operatorname{Spec}L)\xrightarrow{\sim}M^{H_L}$. These bijections are natural in morphisms of sheaves and in all $K$-embeddings $j:L\to L'$ between such fields: if $\sigma\in G$ restricts to $j$ on $L$, then pullback of sections along $\operatorname{Spec}L'\to\operatorname{Spec}L$ corresponds to $m\mapsto\sigma\cdot m$ from $M^{H_L}$ to $M^{H_{L'}}$. This does not depend on the choice of $\sigma$.

source.place: Tag 04JM, Lemma lemma-global-sections-point, direct proof after the formal proof, applied over each finite separable L/K; Tag 03QW, section-galois-action-stalks

proof.text: Construct the canonical lifts by Spec of L into Ks into Omega. Choose the extension to Omega of each g using the proved Galois automorphism extension theorem. This extension is unique: Omega/Ks is algebraic and Ks is separably closed, hence purely inseparable, and IsPurelyInseparable.injective_comp_algebraMap gives uniqueness. This uniqueness proves that extension preserves identity and multiplication.

source.place: Tags 03QW and 04JM; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03QW and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/04JM

proof.text: Changing a lift by Spec of the extended automorphism defines a compatible cocone with values in the stalk. Point.presheafFiberDesc constructs its map. On a germ it is exactly the changed lift, by toPresheafFiber_presheafFiberDesc. Prove identity and multiplication on every germ using joint surjectivity and the contravariant Spec composition formula. These maps define the actual MulAction; no unproved existence theorem is used to choose its data.

source.place: Tags 03QW and 04JM; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03QW and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/04JM

proof.text: Prove injectivity of each finite-field germ map directly. Point.toPresheafFiber_eq_iff' supplies a pointed refinement. Its underlying map to Spec L is surjective since Spec L has one point and the refinement has the geometric lift. Its singleton sieve is covering. Presieve.isSeparatedFor_singleton applied to F.property makes restriction injective.

source.place: Tags 03QW and 04JM; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03QW and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/04JM

proof.text: If g fixes L, its extension fixes the canonical lift through Spec L. The lift-change formula therefore puts every section germ in the H_L-fixed subset. The new invariant-germ representative theorem proves surjectivity onto that subset. Combining this with germ injectivity gives Set.BijOn.

source.place: Tags 03QW and 04JM; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03QW and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/04JM

proof.text: For j:L to L' extended by g, compute the moved lift as the canonical lift of L' composed with etaleSpecMap j, using the equations for g and its extension to Omega. The colimit relation toPresheafFiber_w_apply gives embedding compatibility. Represent a fixed m by a section using surjectivity; applying compatibility for g and g' gives equal germs over L', fixed by H_L' by the mapsTo clause. This proves subgroup invariance and choice-independence without a separate conjugation lemma.

source.place: Tags 03QW and 04JM; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03QW and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/04JM

proof.text: Section-germ naturality is Point.toPresheafFiber_naturality_apply. For action equivariance, represent any stalk element by a germ, apply the constructed changeGerm formula on both sheaves, and apply that same naturality identity.
